select * from copy_into_table;

copy into copy_into_table(

    Dealer_id 1,
    Model_id 2,
    Branch_id 3,
    Date_id 4,
    Units_Sold  5, 
    revenue 6

)
from 'https://sambhavdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/automobile/'
with 
(

    FILE_FORMAT = CsvFileFormat,
    CREDENTIAL=(IDENTITY='Managed Identity')
)


-- Create a database scoped credential using Managed Identity
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL sambhavcreds
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

-- Then, you bind this credential to an external data source:

-- Create external data source pointing to your storage
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE MyDataLake
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://sambhavdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = sambhavcreds
);

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT CsvFileFormat
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 2
    )
);

drop table  iris_data;
CREATE TABLE iris_data (
    id float,  -- Assuming '#' is a row number or unique identifier
    sepal_length FLOAT,
    sepal_width FLOAT,
    petal_length FLOAT,
    petal_width FLOAT,
    variety VARCHAR(50)  -- Typically values like 'Setosa', 'Versicolor', 'Virginica'
)
WITH(
    DISTRIBUTION=ROUND_ROBIN
)

copy into iris_data(
    id ,
    sepal_length ,
    sepal_width ,
    petal_length ,
    petal_width,
    variety 
)
from 'https://sambhavdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/automobile/'
with 
(

    FILE_TYPE='PARQUET',
    CREDENTIAL=(IDENTITY='Managed Identity')
)



CREATE TABLE iris_data (
    id FLOAT,
    sepal_length FLOAT,
    sepal_width FLOAT,
    petal_length FLOAT,
    petal_width FLOAT,
    variety VARCHAR(50)
);
